options.name: Facilitated Wine Tasting
options.detail: Facilitated tastings at the winery tasting room

blurb: Barking Rocks Winery handcrafts small batches of premium wines from Texas-grown grapes in an old rock barn near Granbury. Guests can visit the tasting room on Saturdays for facilitated tastings and to purchase wines. The winery hosts limited events mainly during Saturday tastings.
extraNote: For groups over 8, please contact the winery · At the winery, greeted by Ripple the mascot at the gate
